schema.description: One feature per tailings deposit. Geometry: Polygon/MultiPolygon in WGS84 (lon, lat), the deposit footprint. Source: Plataforma Publica de Relaves (Sernageomin).

required_properties.nombre: string, deposit name as published by Sernageomin
required_properties.split: one of train | val | test (assigned per deposit, never per tile)

optional_properties.sernageomin_id: string, identifier in the Sernageomin registry
optional_properties.todo: boolean, true marks a placeholder feature; placeholders are rejected by every pipeline step
